session.openHint: Pick the store you'll sell from. If you have one assigned, it's already set.
session.warehouseEmpty: You have no store to sell from. Ask an administrator to give you access to one.
session.closeHint: If the drawer doesn't balance, it closes anyway and the difference is recorded.
session.pdfFailed: We couldn't download the PDF. Try again with the button.
session.notePlaceholder: For example: a 20 bill was missing
session.openingCashHint: The cash you start with to give change. It's added to the expected cash when you close.

cart.cameraUnavailable: We couldn't use the camera. You can still search by typing.
cart.empty: The cart is empty. Scan or search to start.
cart.clearBody: This removes the {{count}} products from the cart.
cart.clearBody_one: This removes 1 product from the cart.
cart.integersOnly: This presentation only takes whole numbers.
cart.noResults: We found nothing sellable from this store.
cart.outOfStock: More than what's in this store
cart.scanHint: Line the barcode up horizontally, over the line
cart.searchPlaceholder: Scan, type the code, the name, or a {{prefix}}- number…

quote.author: Quoted by
quote.cancelBody: Quote {{folio}} stops being valid: if the customer comes back with the printout, it can no longer be charged. Nothing is deleted — it stays in the list as Canceled.
quote.unavailable: No longer sold from this store
quote.warehouseEmpty: You have no store to quote from. Ask an administrator to give you access to one.
quote.warehouseHint: Prices and availability are calculated from this store. Quoting needs no open shift.

history.cancelBody: Sale {{folio}} gets reversed: the stock returns to the store and the opposite movement stays in the ledger. Nothing is deleted — it can be audited later.
history.empty: There are no sales to show yet.
history.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the customer returned everything
history.title: Sales history

ticket.failed: We couldn't open the receipt. You can reprint it from the history.

discount.codeHint: Set by the administrator in My profile.
discount.exceedsSubtotal: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal
discount.exceedsLimit: The discount exceeds the business limit ({{max}}% of the subtotal)

cashMovement.title: Cash paid in and out
cashMovement.intro: Record cash you put into or take out of your drawer without a sale. When you close, cash paid in is added to the expected cash and cash paid out is subtracted.
cashMovement.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
cashMovement.empty: No cash has been paid in or out this shift yet.
cashMovement.loadFailed: We couldn't load this shift's movements.
cashMovement.cancelBody: Nothing is deleted: it stays in the list, crossed out with your reason, and no longer counts toward the expected cash.
cashMovement.cancelReasonPlaceholder: For example: it was recorded twice
